meaning:
ἐμφανής, -ές
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: Mic.4:1, Isa.2:2 (כּוּן ni.), Wis.6:22 7:21 14:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Exo.2:14 (יָדַע ni.), Isa.65:1 (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;]
manifest: Act.10:40; metaphorically, Rom.10:20 (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,
Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
